result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is unexpectedly clipped mid-character.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is abruptly clipped mid-character on the final 'n' (appearing as 'Tokumaru Rameı'), despite having ample empty horizontal space before the rating.
issues.suggestion: Expand the title text container's width or remove the restrictive max-width constraint, and apply proper text wrapping or ellipsis truncation if space is actually constrained.
